name: rae goes to magfest 2026
preview_alt: Dithered photograph reading "Rae goes to Magfest 2026: a non-encompassing video log".
long_desc: A very small snippet of my very sweet time at MAGFest 2026, up the National Harbor in Maryland. The journey had me span the entire country — twice! — and I got to meet a lot of good friends, play a lot of good games, and eat a lot of good food. See you next year!

name: Cloudburst
preview_alt: Footage of Cloudburst. A low-power idle screen shows the time, battery status, and local weather. A new menu comes up from the bottom of the screen, showing more detailed weather info.
short_desc: Weather you like it or not
long_desc: Curious what the forecast looks like? Easy! But...your laptop's out of reach, your phone's battery is dead, your smart assistant's brain is busted, and your curtains are shut. It's just you, and your Playdate. Well, now you're in luck!

name: Rev Checker
preview_alt: Screenshot of Rev Checker. "Your Playdate is... rev B! You've got a Playdate that was shipped during or after Group 4. You're a powerhouse!"
long_desc: This one-time tool lets you see your Playdate's hardware revision. What's that supposed to mean? Hopefully nothing — it's just a CPU swap that happened during the console's life. But the info is handy for the odd debug! The website has more info about the chip swap, as well as the app download for your Playdate.

name: Crankyboard
preview_alt: Dithered screenshot of Crankyboard. A few high scores in a video game are shown.
long_desc: In its prime, Crankyboard was the premier way to view Playdate game scoreboards — backed by a retrospectively-hilarious, entirely-manual API scraping process. Today, it's a fun time capsule of lessons learned, and very old high scores.

name: Moth Rotatotron 3D
preview_alt: Looping animation of a 1-bit, pre-rendered 3D model of a moth spinning around and around.
long_desc: A super-quick test of 3D pre-rendering on Playdate, featuring a moth in 360 degrees of pure glory. I even made the model myself!

name: GBGen
preview_alt: Logo for GBGen, a quick-and-dirty GBG idea generator. There's a question mark with quizzical eyes.
long_desc: Wanna make a game for Game Builder Garage, but not sure where to start? This tool will help you out! Find some inspiration, enjoy the confetti, and see if you can't spot some silly little secrets along the way.

name: Mobile Game Name Generator
preview_alt: 1-bit dithered preview of the Mobile Game Name Generator. A big panel reads "Forge of Gladiators: Journey of War", with a button below to generate another name.
long_desc: Ever needed a killer name for that medieval civilization-building mobile game idea burning a hole in your pocket? Well, now you're in luck!
